Class PlacementManager

java.lang.Object
game.ui.PlacementManager
public class PlacementManager extends Object
Manages the interactive placement and removal of machines on the game grid. Translates mouse input into grid coordinates, handles inventory consumption, and delegates UI updates and sound effects via callbacks.

  • Constructor Details

    • PlacementManager

      public PlacementManager(GridSystem logicGrid, PlayerBank bank, BooleanSupplier isShopVisible, Supplier<MachineType> getActiveSelection, Function<MachineType, Integer> getInventoryCount, Consumer<MachineType> consumeFromInventory, Consumer<MachineType> returnToInventory, Runnable refreshUI, Consumer<String> onHintText, Runnable onPlaceSound, Runnable onRemoveSound)
      Initializes the placement manager with necessary game state dependencies and interaction callbacks.
      Parameters:
      logicGrid - The core logic grid where machines are placed and removed.
      bank - The player's bank, required for initializing certain machine types.
      isShopVisible - Supplier to check if the shop is currently obscuring the grid.
      getActiveSelection - Supplier to retrieve the currently selected machine type from the inventory UI.
      getInventoryCount - Function to check the available quantity of a specific machine type.
      consumeFromInventory - Callback to deduct a machine from the player's inventory upon placement.
      returnToInventory - Callback to refund a machine to the player's inventory upon removal.
      refreshUI - Callback to trigger a visual update of the inventory UI.
      onHintText - Callback to push dynamic instructional text to the player interface.
      onPlaceSound - Callback to trigger a sound effect when a machine is successfully built.
      onRemoveSound - Callback to trigger a sound effect when a machine is successfully removed.
